idea: Use a "staircase merge" family on the k×k grid with k = ⌈√n⌉+1. Merge disjoint 2×2 blocks along the diagonal into single squares of side 2/k, each removing 3 from the count and adding 1/k to the sum. Also allow 3×3 merges, each removing 8 and adding 2/k, and choose the counts by a small knapsack to hit n exactly with the maximal sum.
